text: Comms capsule panel labels the capsule's clock as 'PROBE CLOCK YOU SEE' although this panel is about Ines's capsule (CAPSULE · WHAT YOU SEE). Also the 'ship clock' header and the big 47.7 M number are unexplained.

After the rescue completed (tick 3406, Ines: 'Engine's lit... I'm climbing'), the comms capsule view keeps showing her falling deeper (appears at 6.5 rs, redshift 1.32, 'Falling. It looks almost normal from here.'), and a new pre-rescue-sounding line arrives ('Everything overhead is so bright...'). Radio and image both travel at light speed, so after hearing she's climbing I expected the picture to show her climbing too; the mixed signals made me doubt whether the rescue worked.

A 'Chrome for Testing ... only for automated testing' infobar covers the top ~57 px of the 1280x720 window for the whole session, pushing the game view down and partly hiding the ship/relay clock strip in some views (harness/launcher issue, not the game itself).
